The mission loop

Assemble.
Deploy. Defend.

Make your decisions before the battle. Learn from each wave. Rebuild your strategy between encounters.

01 / ASSEMBLE

Give every part a purpose.

Combine frames, energy cores, and specialist modules to manufacture your squad. Choose from seven robot types, from scouts and artillery to repair and shield units.

02 / DEPLOY

Make positioning count.

Arrange robots on a 4 × 3 deployment grid. Match your formation to the enemy preview and use energy circuits to strengthen your plan.

03 / DEFEND

Adapt between waves.

Watch your formation fight, tap enemies to focus fire, then spend your rewards on manufacturing, repairs, and upgrades before the next encounter.

Inside RIVYNTH

Your squad. Your strategy.

Mission support

Ready for
another wave?

Play offline, replay unlocked missions, and pursue a better star rating. Your mission progress and audio preferences are saved on your device.

Created by yunpeng for iPhone and iPad.

How do I start a battle?

Manufacture robots, then drag them from the bench onto the deployment grid. Deploy two robots for the first wave, or at least one for later waves, and select Start Battle.

Can I repair or change my squad?

Between waves, use preparation to manufacture, repair, upgrade, dismantle, sell, or reposition your units. Balance the next upgrade against the resources you need to survive.

Does RIVYNTH need an account or internet?

No account or internet connection is needed to play. The current game has no third-party advertising or analytics SDKs.

Where is my progress stored?

Unlocked missions, best star ratings, and sound preferences are stored locally. Removing the app can remove that data. Device backups are controlled by your Apple settings.
